detail.permanentTitle: Making it permanent is a deployment step.
detail.permanentText: Try only loads it in this tab. For everyone: deploy the bundle (JAR or hosted file), then list its namespace in the deployment's config.json:
detail.alreadyDeployed: Already deployed here but switched off? The Library lists it under “Available but disabled”, with the same value.

try.title: Try “{{name}}” in this tab?
try.theme: A theme only changes colors, fonts and spacing. It is applied immediately, in this tab — no reload.
try.local: This plugin is already deployed on this server but switched off by configuration. Nothing is downloaded — it is activated for your tab only, exactly as if it were enabled.
try.remote: This runs third-party code from <host/> with your administrator privileges in this browser.
try.pinned: The bundle is integrity-pinned: only the exact reviewed build will execute.
try.notPinned: This entry is not integrity-pinned — the bundle is trusted as served by its host.
try.tabOnly: Nothing is installed or enabled for anyone else. The trial is active only in this tab and ends when you close it.
try.overlapsTail: . Two plugins in one slot don't compose — whichever registers last wins.
try.pause_one: Pause in this tab while trying — End trial brings it back. Nothing changes for anyone else.
try.pause_other: Pause in this tab while trying — End trial brings them back. Nothing changes for anyone else.
try.reloads: The page reloads to activate it.

library.lead: Everything running in this deployment: shipped with the app, deployed as JARs, or on trial in this tab.
library.intro: Enabling a plugin for the whole organisation is a deployment step: add its namespace to app.enabledPlugins in config.json (every row has a copy button for that value). A plugin can additionally be switched off at runtime via .

groups.activeHint: Running on this deployment right now
groups.trialHint: Loaded in this tab only — gone when it closes
groups.pausedHint: Stepped aside for a trial — back when it ends
groups.disabledHint: Present on this deployment, switched off by configuration

library.emptyActive: Nothing is registered — that would be a broken boot; check the console.

badge.registryNewerHint: The registry lists a newer version. Updating is a deployment step.

library.copyNamespaceHint: Copy — this is the app.enabledPlugins value
library.moduleOf: A module of the plugin, registered under its own namespace. It is switched on and off together with in app.enabledPlugins, not separately.
library.browserInstalled: Installed in this browser by the previous marketplace (localStorage{{ids}}). It loads on every visit from this browser only — nobody else sees it. Remove it in the previous marketplace's Library, or clear that key.
library.pausedText: Enabled for everyone, stepped aside in this tab so a trial can fill its slots. Ending that trial brings it back.
library.disabledNotListed: Present, but not listed in app.enabledPlugins. To enable it for everyone, add to that list in the deployment's config.json.

themeCard.configValueHint: The app.theme value that applies this theme for everyone
themeCard.copyHint: Copy — set this as app.theme to apply it for everyone
themeCard.externalHint: A deployment hosts the CSS itself before it can set app.theme.
